headline: One dead, two injured in Mussoorie crash
article_text: On 9 June 2025, a speeding car collided near Mussoorie at 10:30 pm. Two people were injured and one person died.

headline: देहरादून में सड़क हादसा
article_text: 9 जून 2025 को देहरादून में सड़क हादसा हुआ। दो लोग घायल हुए और एक व्यक्ति की मौत हो गई। रात 10 बजे बस और कार टकराईं।

headline: No injuries in Doiwala bus rollover
article_text: On 2025-01-05 a bus overturned in Doiwala. No one was injured.

headline: Truck crash near Chakrata
article_text: A truck crash happened near Chakrata on 2025-02-03. Two people were injured, but a later update says three were injured.
